title: Device config - response  (server -> firmware)
description: System.Text.Json serialization (ASP.NET Core Web defaults => camelCase property names, null values KEPT) of api.Models.DeviceConfig, produced by DeviceApiController.BuildDeviceConfigAsync(). Returned by BOTH POST /api/Device/Config AND POST /api/Device/Register. Roadmap #34: Config returns this body when EITHER the device's ConfigVersion differs from the server's OR a command is pending for the device (pendingCommand non-null) - the server returns 200 with an EMPTY body only when neither is true. Firmware parses it in DeviceController::loadConfig(). This file and register.response.schema.json are identical by construction - keep them in sync.

deviceID.description: Lowercase 'd' - the C# property is literally 'deviceID', so camelCase serialization leaves it unchanged. Firmware reads config["deviceID"].

deviceTypeServiceID.description: 0 http, 1 https, 2 mqtt. Drives DeviceController::serviceType() in steady-state operation.

servicePublicKey.description: Pinned CA/self-signed cert for self-hosted deployments; null => firmware validates the TLS chain against its embedded CA bundle.

loRaGatewayEnabled.description: Roadmap #383. Lets an ordinary, already-registered device also relay LoRa private-protocol uplinks via its own WiFi/HTTP connection; firmware only actually starts listening if it detects the LoRa radio chip physically present, reporting DeviceEventType.LoRaHardwareNotDetected otherwise.

utcOffsetSeconds.description: Roadmap #39. Current UTC offset in seconds (positive east of UTC) for ServerConfig.ScheduleTimeZone, computed fresh on every response via TimeZoneHelper.GetUtcOffsetSeconds. 0 when no schedule timezone is configured. Firmware adds this to the NTP epoch and feeds the result to gmtime() to get local calendar fields with no on-device timezone database.

serverUtcEpoch.description: Roadmap #381. Server wall-clock (Unix seconds) at response time, sent on every poll. Firmware seeds its epoch from this value only while NTP has never synced (fully offline self-hosted install) - DeviceController::applyServerEpochFallback is a no-op once real NTP time is available.

firmwareVersion.description: Roadmap #3 (OTA). The newest published firmware version for this device's type; non-null only when firmwareUpdate is true and a deviceFirmware row exists. The firmware compares it against its compiled-in version before downloading.

firmwareUrl.description: Roadmap #3 (OTA). HTTP(S) URL of the .bin to flash; paired with firmwareVersion, same null conditions.

firmwareSha256.description: Roadmap #131. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the .bin at firmwareUrl (DeviceFirmware.Sha256), when the catalog has one - OtaController hashes the download while streaming it to flash and aborts before Update.end() on a mismatch. Null whenever the source has no manifest hash to offer (e.g. a Custom repository without one); the firmware then skips verification rather than failing closed.

emergencyStop.description: Roadmap #230. Tenant-wide fail-closed switch (Tenant.EmergencyStopActive) - true forces every relay off ahead of any rule, independent of deviceConfigController's own relayEnabled.

simulationModeEnabled.description: Roadmap #251 modality A. True tells firmware to start polling GET /api/Device/Simulation every 5s (or on every wake if sleepDeep) for per-metric sensor-reading overrides, applying them before local controller logic runs - same table/principle for a real device as for a fully virtual one (roadmap #343).

deviceConfigSensor.description: Populated only when deviceSensorEnabled is true; otherwise serialized as null (System.Text.Json keeps the key).

deviceConfigController.description: Populated only when deviceControllerEnabled is true; otherwise serialized as null.

pendingCommand.description: Roadmap #34. Null when there is nothing to do; present only for a real, unexpired Pending command.

schemaVersion.description: Roadmap #451(23). Which config wire-format version the server generated this response with (Agrumy.Shared.Models.ConfigSchemaVersions.Current) - firmware compares this against its own CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION (DeviceModel.h) and logs (does not reject) when the server is ahead, so a stale-firmware mismatch is visible during OTA rollback triage instead of a silently-ignored new field.

sensorBattery.description: Roadmap #12. FK into deviceTypeSensor: 0/null=Disabled(None), 1009=MAX17048 (I2C fuel gauge, recommended), 2001=Analog voltage (VoltageDivider, fallback/necessity).

batteryDividerR1.description: Roadmap #12. VoltageDivider only (sensorBattery=2001): the actual R1 resistor wired, in ohms. V_battery = V_measured * (R1+R2)/R2. Ignored by MAX17048.

batteryDividerR2.description: Roadmap #12. VoltageDivider only (sensorBattery=2001): the actual R2 resistor wired, in ohms.

sensorPH.description: C# property is 'SensorPH'; camelCase leaves the 'PH' suffix uppercase -> 'sensorPH'.

weightCalibrationFactor.description: Roadmap #416. HX711 set_scale() divisor - raw counts per real-world unit, calibrated per install.

weightTareOffset.description: HX711 set_offset() raw reading with the scale empty, applied every boot instead of tare()ing whatever's currently on the scale.

ecCalibrationSlope.description: Roadmap #416. No universal analog-EC-probe formula exists - identity default (1.0) reports raw millivolts until calibrated against known-EC reference solutions.

deviceConfigController.description: camelCase serialization of api.Models.DeviceConfigController. Roadmap #21: threshold/hysteresis/interval/schedule all replaced by 'rules', resolved from the device's ASSIGNED ZONE (DeviceApiController.BuildDeviceConfigAsync), not from this device's own row - only relay-pin mapping below is still per-device.

rules.description: Roadmap #21. Every automation rule for the zone this device is assigned to - empty when unassigned. Several rules may target the SAME relayFunction: OR semantics, any rule that evaluates on wins (AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::evaluateRule/initController).

waterPumpMaxRunSeconds.description: Roadmap #21/#36. Hard ceiling (seconds) on continuous WaterPump run time, enforced device-side AFTER any rule decides the pump should run - AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::applyWaterPumpSafetyLimits. Copied from the assigned zone (api.Models.DeviceFarmUnitZone), not this row. 0/null disables it.

waterPumpCooldownSeconds.description: Roadmap #21/#36. Minimum OFF time (seconds) before the next WaterPump attempt is allowed, same enforcement point as waterPumpMaxRunSeconds. Copied from the assigned zone. 0/null disables it.

waterPumpMinLevel.description: Roadmap #393. Dry-run protection - blocks WaterPump (Interval/Schedule/Manual included, not just Threshold) below this fill percent, evaluated device-side against waterLevelRawEmpty/waterLevelRawFull (AgrumyFirmware's RelayLogic::waterPumpBlockedByLowTank). Copied from the assigned zone. <=0/null, or waterLevelRawEmpty==waterLevelRawFull, disables it.

waterLevelRawEmpty.description: Roadmap #234/#393. Raw sensorData.WaterLevel reading when the tank is empty - same calibration api.Utils.TankCalculator uses server-side, sent here so waterPumpMinLevel can be evaluated on-device.

waterLevelRawFull.description: Roadmap #234/#393. Raw sensorData.WaterLevel reading when the tank is full - see waterLevelRawEmpty.

skipWaterPumpForRain.description: Roadmap #11. Final AND-NOT veto over WaterPump, computed server-side (DeviceApiController.BuildDeviceConfigAsync) from the assigned zone's SkipWaterPumpWhenRainPredicted AND the install-wide ServerConfig.WeatherRainPredicted - applied by AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::initController AFTER the OR of all WaterPump rules, same architectural slot as waterPumpMaxRunSeconds/waterPumpCooldownSeconds above.

heatingFailSafePolicy.description: What a Heating rule does once its temperature reading has been stale (NaN) for longer than AgrumyFirmware's MAX_HEATING_SENSOR_STALE_SECONDS - copied from the assigned zone's own field (api.Models.HeatingFailSafePolicyType: 0=Hold, 1=Off, 2=ScheduleOnly). Null (zone never set one) and any unrecognized value both fall back to Hold, AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::evaluateRule.

manualOverrides.description: Roadmap #219. Only what's still active (not yet past expiresAtEpoch) - a naturally-expired command simply stops appearing here on the next poll, no explicit stop message needed. Applied by AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::initController AFTER the rules' OR and the WaterPump rain veto, winning over both.

relays.description: Roadmap #309. One entry per physically-wired relay slot with a function assigned - a slot with no entry is unassigned/disabled. Replaces the old fixed relay1..relay8 keys, removing the hardcoded 8-slot ceiling from the wire format itself (AgrumyFirmware's own MAX_RELAY_SLOTS still caps how many a given firmware build can hold).

deviceFarmUnitZoneRule.description: Roadmap #21/#212/#396(4). camelCase serialization of api.Models.DeviceFarmUnitZoneRule - the SAME class the DB/admin-API CRUD side uses (not split into a firmware-only DTO), so every property below is always present on the wire even though a rule reaching a device is always already resolved to Zone scope and filtered to Relay action (api.Devices.RuleHierarchyResolver) - tenantID/deviceFarmUnitID/actionType/notificationSubject/notificationBody are consequently fixed/null shapes here, never meaningfully read by firmware.

tenantID.description: Admin-API/DB concern only - firmware has no notion of tenant.

deviceFarmID.description: Roadmap #384. Set only for a Farm-scope rule - never seen here, since a rule reaching a device is already resolved to a specific Zone (RuleHierarchyResolver).

deviceFarmUnitID.description: Set only for a Unit-scope rule - never seen here, since a rule reaching a device is already resolved to a specific Zone (RuleHierarchyResolver).

deviceFarmUnitZoneID.description: Which zone this rule belongs to - redundant with the top-level deviceConfig.deviceFarmUnitZoneID (the device already knows its own zone). Never actually null on a rule that reached a device (a rule only reaches firmware after RuleHierarchyResolver has already pinned it to this specific zone), the type stays nullable here only because it mirrors the same always-present-class as the Unit/Global-scope rows the admin-API CRUD side also serializes with this definition.

simulationSessionID.description: Set only for a Simulation-scope rule - a rule reaching a device is already resolved to a specific Zone (RuleHierarchyResolver) regardless of which scope originally won, so this stays null on the wire just like deviceFarmID/deviceFarmUnitID above.

experimentID.description: Set only for an Experiment-scope rule - same always-null-on-the-wire reasoning as simulationSessionID above, a resolved rule carries no scope marker.

actionType.description: 1=Relay, 2=Notification (api.Models.ActionType) - always 1 here, a Notification-action rule is never sent to a device (api.BackgroundWorkers.RuleNotificationEvaluator evaluates those server-side instead).

relayFunction.description: 1=Ventilation, 2=Light, 3=Heating, 4=WaterPump, 5=Screen, 6=Vent (api.Models.RelayFunction) - which of the device's relay slots this rule targets, resolved device-side against its OWN relays[]/pwmSlots[] mapping above (the rule itself carries no slot number).

name.description: Roadmap #396(4). Admin-facing label, required - never read by firmware, only used server-side for Notification-rule hierarchy override-by-name (api.Devices.RuleHierarchyResolver).

description.description: Roadmap #396(4). Optional admin-facing note - never read by firmware.

root.description: Roadmap #396(4). Recursive condition tree replacing the old flat conditions[] array - a GroupNode's children may nest arbitrarily (AgrumyFirmware's RelayLogic::evaluateNode), up to MAX_NODES_PER_RULE(8) total nodes and MAX_CHILDREN_PER_GROUP(4) per group.

targetPercent.description: Required for every Relay rule regardless of function (roadmap #470) - the 0-100 demand this rule asserts while root evaluates true; several simultaneously-true rules for the same function fold to the HIGHEST targetPercent among them.

isSafetyRule.description: Roadmap #396(5). Survives RuleHierarchyResolver's normal scope-override even when a more specific scope has its own rule(s) for the same relayFunction - ORs in alongside whichever rule 'won'. Not read by firmware itself, already resolved into the final rule set server-side.

conditionNode.description: Roadmap #396(4). camelCase serialization of api.Models.ConditionNode - a flat tagged-union, recursive only via the group/children case; only the fields matching type are meaningful, the rest are null. Astronomical(5)/RuleTriggered(6)/RateOfChange(7)/DifDisruption(8) never reach this wire shape - Astronomical is resolved into an effective Schedule node server-side (api.Devices.AstronomicalRuleResolver) before a rule ever reaches a device, and the other three only ever appear inside a Notification-action rule, which is never sent to a device at all (only Relay-action rules are).

type.description: 1=Comparison, 2=Interval, 3=Schedule, 4=Group (api.Models.NodeType) - selects which of the fields below are meaningful. 5=Astronomical/6=RuleTriggered never reach this wire shape, see this definition's own remarks.

metric.description: Comparison only. 1-13=RAW (a real sensor reading), 14+=DERIVED (computed on-the-fly by AgrumyFirmware's RelayLogic::readMetric, never stored) - api.Models.SensorMetric's numeric values exactly.

operator.description: Comparison only. 1=GT, 2=LT (both carry the old Threshold condition's dead-zone latch via hysteresis), 3=GTE, 4=LTE, 5=EQ, 6=BETWEEN (all three stateless, no latch) - api.Models.ComparisonOperator.

hysteresis.description: Comparison, GT/LT operators only - dead-zone margin, must not be negative (enforced server-side, DeviceFarmUnitApiController.NodeConfigError).

intervalLength.description: Interval only. Must not exceed interval (enforced server-side).

daysOfWeek.description: Schedule only. 7-bit mask, bit 0 = Sunday .. bit 6 = Saturday (matches C's tm_wday - see AgrumyFirmware's RelayLogic::evaluateNode).

start.description: Schedule only. Seconds since LOCAL midnight (DeviceConfig.utcOffsetSeconds resolves 'local'), 0-86399.

duration.description: Schedule only. Seconds. start+duration must not exceed 86400 (no crossing local midnight in v1) - enforced server-side, DeviceFarmUnitApiController.NodeConfigError.

sunriseOffsetMinutes.description: Astronomical only - never present here, see this definition's own remarks.

sunsetOffsetMinutes.description: Astronomical only - never present here, see this definition's own remarks.

referencedRuleId.description: RuleTriggered only - never present here, see this definition's own remarks.

groupOperator.description: Group only. 1=AND, 2=OR (api.Models.LogicalOperator) - folds children strictly left-to-right, never re-associated.

children.description: Group only, empty array otherwise - up to MAX_CHILDREN_PER_GROUP(4) direct children, each recursively any node type including another Group.

windowHours.description: RateOfChange only - never present here, see this definition's own remarks.

changeThreshold.description: RateOfChange only - never present here, see this definition's own remarks.

nightWindowHours.description: DifDisruption only - never present here, see this definition's own remarks.

dayWindowHours.description: DifDisruption only - never present here, see this definition's own remarks.

minDifDegrees.description: DifDisruption only - never present here, see this definition's own remarks.

relayFunction.description: 1=Ventilation, 2=Light, 3=Heating, 4=WaterPump (api.Models.RelayFunction) - only Ventilation/Heating/WaterPump are ever actually sent, Light cannot be manually actuated.

mode.description: 1=Duration (unconditional while inside the window), 2=Target (reuses the same dead-zone threshold math as an automated Threshold condition) - api.Models.ManualOverrideMode.

expiresAtEpoch.description: Unix seconds. Hard safety cap regardless of mode - past this, the override no longer applies this tick even if a Target-mode condition would otherwise say to force on.

targetMetric.description: Target mode only - 1=Temperature, 3=Humidity, 5=Moisture (api.Models.SensorMetric's numeric values, only this subset is valid here). Null for Duration mode.

targetThreshold.description: Target mode only, null for Duration mode.

targetHysteresis.description: Target mode only, null for Duration mode.

deviceRelaySlot.description: Roadmap #309. camelCase serialization of api.Models.DeviceRelaySlot - one physically-wired relay position and the function assigned to it.

slot.description: 1-based physical relay position on this device's board - AgrumyFirmware indexes ConfigPin.RELAY_PINS[slot-1] to find the actual GPIO/expander pin.

relayFunction.description: 1=Ventilation, 2=Light, 3=Heating, 4=WaterPump (api.Models.RelayFunction) - never 0/Disabled, a disabled slot is simply omitted from the relays array rather than sent with this value.

pendingCommand.description: Roadmap #34. camelCase serialization of api.Models.PendingCommand - the one oldest, unexpired Pending deviceCommand row for this device, if any.

idDeviceCommand.description: Echo this back as CommandId in the Ack call (POST /api/Device/Command/Ack) and in the CommandExecuted event (POST /api/Device/Event).

actionType.description: 1=Reboot, 2=ForceOTA, 3=ForceConfigSync (api.Models.CommandActionType) - same server->firmware raw-int convention as relayFunction/deviceTypeServiceID, not a string.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. A command not acked/executed by this time must not be acted on if somehow still received - matches the server's own lazy-expiry check.

payload.description: JSON string for ProvisionDevice/UpdateWifiCredentials (api.Models.DiscoveryProvisionPayload / WifiUpdatePayload), null for every other actionType.
